---
title: "The Handbook for the Recently Enrolled"
subtitle: "An Operating Manual for Graduate Researchers"
description: "A practical, evidence-informed operating manual for graduate researchers."
---

Graduate research rarely fails because nobody can find another definition of methodology. It becomes difficult when several reasonable actions are available, the evidence is incomplete, the rules vary by institution, and the next useful move is unclear.

This handbook is built for those moments. It helps you identify the decision in front of you, do proportionate due diligence, record what you considered, take a defensible next step, and know when local or specialist help is required.

This is a living public edition: it is ready to use now and will continue to be corrected and improved. [About this edition](status.qmd).

## Start from your situation

- **I want to see the complete journey:** open [the whole doctorate checklist](checklists/doctoral-journey.qmd).
- **I have just enrolled:** begin with [your first 90 days](chapters/part-01/02-first-90-days.qmd).
- **I need to work better with my supervisors:** use [roles and expectations](chapters/part-02/04-roles-and-expectations.qmd).
- **I am unsure whether my topic is defensible:** run [topic due diligence](chapters/part-03/08-topic-due-diligence.qmd).
- **I keep searching but cannot stop:** use [the search ladder](chapters/part-04/10-search-ladder.qmd).
- **My project has gone wrong:** begin with [failed studies](chapters/part-11/31-failed-studies.qmd).
- **I cannot work out what kind of problem I have:** go directly to [I’m stuck](stuck/index.qmd).

## How to use the handbook

You do not need to read from cover to cover. Start with the problem you are facing now. Each chapter explains the decision, shows a workable next step and links to a checklist or template when one will help. It also tells you when “good enough” is genuinely enough—and when the issue needs local or specialist help.

A few decisions must follow your university's rules or be made by a specialist. [Local rules and specialist help](support.qmd) lists those cases in one place.

## Help improve it

The handbook is maintained as a living edition. You can [suggest an improvement](contributions/index.qmd), or follow the [step-by-step contribution guide](contributions/how-to-help.qmd). Do not submit confidential research data, identifiable personal information, private correspondence, complaints casework, or unpublished material you cannot share.

The project's questions, priorities and editorial decisions are human-led. AI tools assist with organising suggestions, research support, drafting, consistency checks and technical production. [Read how human judgement and AI assistance are separated](contributions/ai-and-editorial-practice.qmd).
